reviews.x: I normally don't write reviews, but this is one I feel I need to make.  A couple of months ago I decided to grow out my beard and give it a try.  With the hairs getting longer I decided it was time to use a beard wash to keep it looking healthy, and after some careful research I narrowed my choice down to two options.  I chose this beard wash because of the oils and ingredients that were in it, opposed to some others with a bunch of different chemicals and artificial ingredients.  I figured I'd

I've used both "Honest", and the $13 "Professor Fuzzworthy's", and found the performance to be quite similar.  Fuzzworthy comes out slightly ahead, but if you're not up to spending the extra money, this one's good as well.  Don't expect much fragrance to last after the rinse... although sensitive female noses may still pick it up.  It's also great on your face, but if you get any in your eye you'll regret it for hours.

Makes my beard super soft. The longer i use it the more im noticing a fuller beard that is growing faster. Suds up very nicely. Keep on a bar holder away from direct water spray ( in a corner of the shower) as it melts away quickly otherwise. Only thing keeping from a 5 star is i wish it had a stronger woodsy smell. The scent is very light.

reviews.t: wondering if it'll smell good to your lady? It will!
reviews.x: I first bought the tea tree oil scent for my boyfriend for Christmas and he loved it! When he ran out, I decided to order him this version instead. Oh my gosh, so nice! The whole bathroom smells like this woodsy scent whenever he takes a shower! And the smells stays all day, even after a 9 hour shift at a busy restaurant! Plus it keeps his beard soft and shiny! A must have for bearded men.

I am addicted to this soap. The pine-y smell is outdoorsy and manly. It took some getting used to but now i love it. It lathers up real good. This one bar will last me months and months. A must have for beards

I bought this soap for my beard and decided to go whole hoge with it. I travel and camp alot so I didn't want to lug around a bunch of different soaps and shampoos and beard guck. So far I like it... everywhere, my beard is not as course and unruly as it used to be and my hair and skin feel much cleaner than before. I also use honest amish beard balm on my beard and hair. I have only been using for about a week and if the results stay consistent I may order more.  The only problem is that the ba

Very nice soap leaves my beard feeling clean and fresh. The scent is very mild and only present when lathering and gone once it is fully washed out. For all the negative reviews on drying out your skin and beard, soap is supposed to remove excess oils. You should always use beard oil after a shower to replenish the oils that were washed away. Beard oil is mainly for the skin under your beard, not just the beard hair. I recommend watching some quality videos on proper beard care.  Also, keep the

At his point i'm all in on any beard soap this company puts out. i've used all of their scents and love them all. On this one i was expecting more of a pine scent, but it's actually closer to cedar. That's not a bad thing at all though. Cedar is actually one of my favorite wood scents!
Buyer beware, you might like the awesome smell of pine and tree bark, makes smooth lather, leaves beard soft and manageable, I'm definitively buying more
Smells great, lasts long, makes my beard happy.
Smells like trees, leaves beard feeling good

I've purchased a different Honest for Men beard soap product before. And just as the other one, this bar is great! Its leaves my beard and face feeling clean and soft, without drying it out. I've tried other products from other companies and I could tell the difference immediately. Part of what makes Honest for Men so good, is that they use all natural ingredients. You really cant asked for much more in a product like this. The only negative I'd have to say about this particular soap, is the sme

I love this beard wash! The scent is very fresh and manly. It cleans my beard well without stripping out all of the oils with harsh chemicals. Leaves the skin on my face feeling refreshed and clean. Haven't found a scent I don't like yet! Lathers very nicely! As with any bar soap, keep it in a draining soap dish away from the stream of water so it'll last longer.

I purchased this 2 days ago because I was running out of some stuff I paid $20 for at a store. It arrived today. Smell is a strong pine scent, possibly made with pine tar. I immediately noticed my beard getting softer. We'll see how it lasts overnight, but well worth the switch. Much friendlier to the wallet, and it works better.

reviews.t: The original smells great. I like them both and would recommend
reviews.x: I've used the original and the black forest...the black forest has very little scent, which was a bit disappointing. The original smells great. I like them both and would recommend, just wish it had more smell to it.

reviews.t: I love how it lathers and smells
reviews.x: I love how it lathers and smells; it is not strong and does not stay too long after the shower. I do keep it on a tray away from the shower spray area as it was a concern some had and have not had any problem yet.
I was not expecting it to be as amazing as it is! the scent is overwhelming for the first few days out of the box, but afterward is perfect and SO soothing when used. My beard is healthier than ever.
Bar of soap has lasted through 5 months of growing beard. My hair naturally gets really oily so I need to wash it every day and this stuff works great keeps the skin under beard healthy too.
Well worth it. I also use it in my hair. Very frothy so a little goes a long ways. washes out extremely well. I will be buying more and probably other products as well.
Really liked the way this made my beard feel and smell. The bar doesn't last super long, so keep it away from dripping water.
Such a great product. BUY BUY BUY. Long lasting and does a great job and softening your beard
My beard loves this soap. The smell is great and it does a great job cleaning my beard.
My favorite scent of the group. Cleans your beard great and smell is delightful

Love that this is very eco conscious, it comes in a paper holder and no more plastic bottles to "recycle" hoping they actually do get recycled. My husband has a thick beard and can get dry scaly patches under his beard. Not anymore with this soap. He can continue to grow it as long as he pleases without his beard getting itchy. Two things I don’t like about this. It’s weird square shape which fits in no travel soap container I have and the scent or lack of. What exactly is the scent? I actually really like the product. It lathers nice. It’s convenient being a bar so no worrying about it leaking. It will last a long time I bet. Just fix the weird shape. I guess you could use the cardboard thingy it comes in, but how long will that last? Lastly the scent. Give me something! I don’t want a cologne but I want to smell some

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as woodsy, pine, or cedar and manly.
Many say the soap leaves their beard soft, clean, and manageable.
Several reviewers note the scent is mild or fades after rinsing, and some wish it were stronger.
Reviewers report the bar lathers well and suds up nicely.
Some warn the bar melts away quickly if not kept away from direct water.
